educational_overlay.purpose: Guides university legal aid clinics and pro-bono advocates through empathetic, structured client interviewing and eligibility screening.
educational_overlay.when_to_use: During first-time clinic interviews with indigent litigants, consumers, or distressed individuals.
educational_overlay.when_not_to_use: To formally retain a client before checking conflict of interest and supervisory advocate authorization.

variables.label: Qualifies for Free Legal Aid (Income < Threshold)

educational_overlay.prompt_template:
Conduct legal clinic intake for client presenting dispute in {{DISPUTE_CATEGORY}} with legal aid eligibility: {{INCOME_ELIGIBILITY}}.
Formulate plain-language interview questions capturing: (1) Sequence of events, (2) Documents held by client, (3) Desired outcome, (4) Immediate urgency/limitation risks.
Draft conflict check notice and supervisor escalation summary.
Do not promise outcome to client. Include [SUPERVISOR SIGN-OFF REQUIRED].
educational_overlay.fictional_scenario: A daily wage worker was defrauded of Rs. 35,000 by an unauthorized job recruitment agency promising an overseas visa.
educational_overlay.sample_output:
### Clinic Intake Record
- **Client**: Smt. Kamala Devi (Income: Rs. 12,000/mo - Eligible under Section 12 LSA Act).
- **Urgency**: Bank UPI transaction occurred 48 hours ago; immediate cyber complaint required.
- **Action Items**: Draft complaint to National Cyber Crime Portal; seek supervisor review.
guardrails: Student clinicians must never provide definitive legal opinions without supervising advocate presence.
verification_checklist: Verify eligibility criteria under Section 12 of Legal Services Authorities Act 1987.
Conduct conflict check against prior clinic consultations.
educational_overlay.ai_risk_warning: Statutory limitation clocks continue running while clinic evaluates representation eligibility.
